ignore.packages/go/store/testdata/slug/vscode-s: the VS Code slugify source that store tests read as data; scripts/record-slugs.mts writes it, and nothing imports it
ignore.examples/board/web/node/model/models.ts: the models that orm-gen generates from the corpus catalog (T15-11); their exports are the API of the models, which the server reads in part

examples/board/web.reason: The npm project of the board example, with its own package.json and package-lock.json, which make flowmark-install installs.

entries.node/main.ts: The Node.js server of the board example, which its README runs, and the files it imports.
entries.client/main.ts: The browser client of the board example, which its README builds.

ignoreDependencies.@polyspec/ordered-json: orm requires it, and npm fetches the release tarball of a dependency that is no direct one only when the project names its URL among its own dependencies (allow-remote=root); no file of the board imports it
